before.text: If you use this bird's power to play another bird with a teal power, you may resolve that power at any point among your other remaining teal powers.

If you use \textbf{Yellowhammer}'s power to play a bird with a round-end (teal) power, you may activate that newly played bird's power, as long as you are still in the round-end power activation step.
